_📐 Maintainability & Code Quality_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Fix the grammar in the `/remove-ticket` description.**

The phrase "so is one another Ticket of the run waits on" is hard to read. "One another" reads as a reciprocal pronoun. Readers cannot easily tell which Ticket gets refused. LanguageTool also flags this line.

<details>
<summary>✏️ Proposed wording</summary>

```diff
-| `/remove-ticket <ticket>` | Take a Ticket out of the live Ticket run: a queued or Parked one, or one whose PR is open (the PR stays open). `/start-ticket` adds it back where it left off. A working one is refused: `/park` it first; so is one another Ticket of the run waits on |
+| `/remove-ticket <ticket>` | Take a Ticket out of the live Ticket run: a queued or Parked one, or one whose PR is open (the PR stays open). `/start-ticket` adds it back where it left off. A working one is refused: `/park` it first. A Ticket that another Ticket of the run waits on is refused too |
```
</details>
